name: sídheóg
text: sídheóg is the unreformed Modern Irish spelling MacKillop records for sióg, the headword for the single Irish fairy. The anglicized form is sheogue. The full record of the single Irish fairy sits under the headword sióg.

attributes.attribute: Unreformed spelling of sióg; pointer to sióg headword

okr.objective: sídheóg is a MacKillop signpost for the sióg headword.
key_results: Signpost cites sióg as the canonical headword.
